body:
## Bug Fix

- **sas**: Keep TextureOffset on the server *[commit by @Rongmario in 3889529]*
- **sdl**: Bring up SDL video before the game settings load *[commit by @Rongmario in c8c9df2]*
- **sdl**: Reapply the mouse grab on macOS when the cursor escapes *[commit by @Rongmario in c4f735e]*
- **sdl**: Keep the splash thread from pumping events on macOS *[commit by @Rongmario in 86568f6]*

## Build and Dependencies

- **deps**: Update lwjgly to 1.0.2 *[commit by @Rongmario in 930c8e8]*
    *[Fixes issue #659 by @MCTian-mi]*
- **deps**: Update Conventions to 1.4.1 *[commit by @Rongmario in 1d2d592]*
- **deps**: Update CleanroomGradle to 0.21.1 *[commit by @Rongmario in 6010e54]*
- **deps**: Update lwjgly to 1.0.1 *[commit by @Rongmario in 63847b5]*

## CI

- Remove the manual publish workflow *[commit by @Rongmario in 314cfa4]*

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/CleanroomMC/Cleanroom/compare/0.7.0-alpha...0.7.1-alpha
scope: Native lab only; active Riven and development API pins unchanged.
